1.stem_plain: The girls have not seen Mr Ong __________ two weeks.

2.stem_plain: The florists __________ at their shop till very late last night.

3.stem_plain: While Mother was cooking for the New Year feast, the kitchen __________ filled with delicious smells.

4.stem_plain: "I __________ Grandpa for a stroll in the park now," I told my mother.

5.stem_plain: Darius __________ in the race a month ago.

6.stem_plain: The children __________ in the room when the lights went out.

7.stem_plain: "May I know where __________ books can be found?" Ali asked the librarian as he showed him a list of titles.

8.stem_plain: I cannot see clearly, __________ I have to wear glasses.

9.stem_plain: Jane bought only __________ souvenirs as she did not want to spend too much money.

10.stem_plain: There is not __________ rice left, so Mother has gone to buy another packet.

1.zh: 女孩们已经两周没有见到王先生了。
1.note: “two weeks”（两周）是一段时间，在现在完成时中，表示某动作持续或中断了一段时间要用介词 for。
1.concept: 时间介词 — Prepositions of Time — for

2.zh: 花商们昨天半夜一直待在他们的店里。
2.note: 时间状语 “last night”（昨天晚上）提示过去时态，主语 “The florists”（复数）对应复数过去式系动词 were。
2.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

3.zh: 当妈妈正在做新年大餐时，厨房里充满了诱人的香味。
3.note: 从句中的 “was cooking” 提示整个情境发生在过去，主语 “the kitchen” 是单数，且被动/状态词表达使用单数过去式 was。
3.concept: 时态一致与系动词过去时 — Simple Past Tense of 'be'

4.zh: “我现在正陪着爷爷在公园里散步呢，”我告诉妈妈。
4.note: 引号里的引语中含有 “now”（现在），提示动词应该使用现在进行时 am accompanying。
4.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

5.zh: 达里厄斯一个月前参加了那场比赛。
5.note: 时间状语 “a month ago”（一个月前）明确提示过去时间，谓语动词应选用一般过去式 ran。
5.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

6.zh: 当灯熄灭时，孩子们正在房间里玩耍。
6.note: “when the lights went out” 提示一个过去的突发动作，它中断了另一个过去正在持续进行的背景动作，因此主句动词使用过去进行时 were playing。
6.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

7.zh: “请问这些书可以在哪里找到？”阿里一边问图书管理员，一边向他展示一纸书单。
7.note: “books” 为复数名词，且根据后半句 “as he showed him a list of titles”（向他展示书单）说明这些书目就在他手头上，处于近处，因此选用表示近称复数的指示代词 these。
7.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — these

8.zh: 我看不清楚，所以我必须戴眼镜。
8.note: “I cannot see clearly”（看不清）是原因，“I have to wear glasses”（得戴眼镜）是结果，前后句属于因果关系，故用连词 so（所以）。
8.concept: 因果连词 — Conjunctions of Result — so

9.zh: 珍只买了几个纪念品，因为她不想花太多钱。
9.note: “souvenirs” 是可数名词复数，且前面有 “only”（仅仅）限制，表示数量少，故选用修饰可数名词的量词短语 a few。
9.concept: 修饰可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — a few

10.zh: 没有剩下多少大米了，所以妈妈去另买一包了。
10.note: “rice”（大米）是不可数名词，且在否定句（There is not）中表达“没剩多少”，要用 much 来修饰。
10.concept: 修饰不可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — much

11.stem_plain: She followed closely to the __________ given in the cake recipe for the required quantity of each ingredient.

12.stem_plain: Mohamed __________ in delight as he read the funny story written by Priya.

13.stem_plain: The river has overflowed due to the __________ rainfall over the week.

14.stem_plain: To help Cindy's family save some money, Aunt Limei offered them her house as their __________ during their visit to China.

15.stem_plain: It will save you a lot of trouble if you do things __________.

16.stem_plain: No one in class dares to __________ Miss Tan's decision as she is the Discipline Mistress.

11.zh: 她严格按照蛋糕食谱中给出的计量，来获取每种原料所需的数量。
11.note: “quantity”（数量）和 “ingredient”（原料）相呼应，表示对分量的要求，选用 “measurements”（计量，测量值）。
11.concept: 名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — measurements

choices.eg: The shoes are available in various sizes to fit everyone perfectly.
The chef demonstrated several advanced cutting techniques during the cooking class.
You must strictly follow the safety procedures before operating the machinery.
Please double-check the measurements of flour and sugar before baking the bread.

12.zh: 莫哈末在读到普里亚写的搞笑故事时，高兴得咯咯笑了起来。
12.note: “funny story”（搞笑故事）和 “in delight”（高兴地）提示这是一种开心的笑，选用 “chuckled”（轻声笑，咯咯笑）。
12.concept: 发声动词辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — chuckled

choices.zh: 发嘘声，低声恶狠狠地说
choices.eg: The angry crowd hissed at the speaker to show their complete disapproval.

choices.zh: 嚎叫，大声哭喊（howled with laughter为狂笑，但单独接in delight不常用）
choices.eg: The wolves howled at the moon throughout the cold winter night.

choices.zh: 倒吸一口气（常因震惊或害怕）
choices.eg: She gasped in shock when she saw the sudden collision on the road.
He chuckled softly to himself while reading the amusing comic strip.

13.zh: 由于这一周的大暴雨，河水已经泛滥了。
13.note: “heavy rainfall” 是固定搭配，意为“大雨、暴雨”，通常是导致河水泛滥（overflowed）的原因。
13.concept: 词汇固定搭配与因果逻辑 — Collocations — heavy rainfall

choices.zh: 富裕的，浓郁的（不修饰雨量）
choices.eg: The soil in this valley is rich and excellent for growing organic vegetables.

choices.zh: 庞大的，笨重的（常修饰行李或包裹）
choices.eg: It is difficult to carry bulky packages on a crowded public bus.

choices.zh: 沉重的，大量的（修饰雨、雪等）
choices.eg: The football match was canceled because of the sudden heavy rain.

choices.zh: 偶尔的，间歇的（程度较轻，不易导致泛滥）
choices.eg: We can expect cloudy conditions with occasional showers in the afternoon.

14.zh: 为了帮辛迪一家省点钱，秀美阿姨提出在他们访问中国期间，让他们住进自己的房子里作为住宿地方。
14.note: 提供“房子”（house）供旅行期间使用，属于提供 “accommodation”（住宿）。
14.concept: 名词词义辨析与语境理解 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — accommodation

choices.eg: The new hotel is in a perfect location right next to the beach.
Turn left when you reach the major traffic junction ahead.
The city provides excellent public transportation including buses and trains.
The travel package includes both hotel accommodation and daily breakfast.

15.zh: 如果你能理智、明智地做事，就会为你省去很多麻烦。
15.note: “save you a lot of trouble”（省去很多麻烦）说明做事情的方式很合理、正确，选用副词 “sensibly”（明智地）。
15.concept: 副词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adverbs) — sensibly

choices.eg: He acted rashly and quit his job before finding a new one.
The tired workers walked wearily back to their tents after a long day.
If you budget your income sensibly, you will always have enough savings.
She searched frantically through her handbag for the lost car keys.

16.zh: 班里没有人敢挑战陈老师的决定，因为她是训导主任。
16.note: “Discipline Mistress”（训导主任）意味着具有权威，因此大家都不敢 “challenge”（挑战、质疑）她的决定。
16.concept: 动词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — challenge

choices.eg: Scientists are going to test the new medicine in the laboratory tomorrow.
We must be brave enough to face our problems instead of running away.

choices.zh: 抵制，反抗（一般不直接说resist a decision，多用于抗拒诱惑或武力）
choices.eg: It was difficult to resist the temptation of eating another slice of cake.

choices.zh: 挑战，质疑（常指对决定或权威提出异议）
choices.eg: The young lawyer decided to challenge the court's final ruling.

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 指代故事的主角“蒂米（Timmy）”。在句中作did not like的主语，且为男性，故使用人称代词主格“he”（他）。

18.note: 指代“他（Timmy）的指甲”。修饰名词复数fingernails，故使用男性形容词性物主代词“his”（他的）。

19.note: 根据后文的“with our bare hands. We need...”，句中已经明确使用了复数代词our和We，说明说话者指的是“我们”，故在主语位置使用人称代词主格“we”（我们）。

20.note: 这是阿沙尔（Ashar）对蒂米（Timmy）说的话，意为“我同意你的看法”。在介词with后面作宾语，故使用第二人称代词宾格“you”（你）。

cloze: Timmy got onto his hands and knees. The reddish-brown soil was dirty and [Q17] did not like the feeling of the dirt on [Q18] fingernails. "[Q19] can't dig with our bare hands. We need the right tools," Timmy told Ashar.
"I agree with [Q20]. The soil is too hard," Ashar faced Timmy and nodded. They left the scene immediately to look for spades.
zh: 蒂米趴在地上。红褐色的土壤很脏，他不喜欢指甲上沾满泥土的感觉。“我们不能用光手去挖。我们需要合适的工具，”蒂米对阿沙尔说。
“我同意你的看法。这土太硬了，”阿沙尔面向蒂米并点了点头。他们立刻离开了现场去寻找铁锹。

29.stem_plain: The cows arrived at the grassland. The cows began grazing.

30.stem_plain: Arun lost the race. Arun was injured.

29.zh: 牛群一到达草地就向开始吃草。
29.note: 使用‘once’（一旦……就……）引导时间状语从句。注意主句中使用代词‘they’来替代‘The cows’以避免重复。
29.answer: The cows began grazing once they arrived at the grassland.

30.zh: 因为阿伦受伤了，所以他输掉了比赛。
30.note: ‘Since’引导原因状语从句，句首大写。因为受伤是输掉比赛的原因，所以应将‘Arun was injured’接在‘Since’后面，主句中的‘Arun’替换为代词‘he’。
30.answer: Since Arun was injured, he lost the race.

paragraphs.1: 第一段从第1行开始，第一段的翻译。
paragraphs.10: 第二段从第10行开始，第二段的翻译。
